basic_info.description: Welcome to this sophisticated 3BD|2BA sunny flat with attached deck, huge back yard, and situated just blocks from Garfield and James Rolph Parks. This sun-drenched home harmonizes modern design with classic touches, featuring an open floor plan that showcases hardwood floors and designer lighting. The spacious backyard offers a serene escape in the city. Inside, the remodeled kitchen is a chef's delight with stone countertops, high-end fixtures, and stainless steel appliances. The residence comprises three generously sized bedrooms, with the third ideal as a guest room or office, complemented by two luxurious bathrooms, one with a walk-in shower and the other with a deep-soaking tub. Keeping tidy is easy with your own sizeable laundry room and huge storage room in the basement. This property is a rare find, offering a blend of style, comfort, and convenience in a prime location, just a short stroll from the vibrant 24th Street, known for its array of shops, restaurants, and cultural hotspots, as well as proximity to BART and major transportation routes. Perfect for those seeking a chic, ready-to-move-in home in the heart of the city.    Offers Due: 7/28
